subject: Two injection-mold halves opening vertically with a single keycap side profile between them: sprue and runner at the top, upper mold half carrying the cavity (negative of the keycap shell) with a small legend recess in the cavity ceiling, the keycap with a hollow underside and center stem tube, a parting line, and the lower mold half carrying the core (positive of the keycap void) with ejector pins and guide-pin bores. Ochre fills the legend cavity.
